reader.title: Playbook reader
reader.intro: The published methodology to read and search, with its guidance and links to the forms, procedures and requirements that implement it.

about.title: About this methodology
about.intro: A practical synthesis inspired by PMI and Brightline foundations, with custom extensions. It is not an official PMI standard.
about.foundationsVerbatim: The Arabic rows are provisional translations; the English source table is the reference.

questions.title: The four guiding questions
questions.intro: Every transformation deliverable answers one of these questions; each template carries its question tag.

search.title: Search the methodology
search.intro: Search the published text in English or Arabic. Matches are marked in each result.
search.noneBody: Try another term, another language or all phases.

browse.title: Browse by phase
browse.intro: The playbook blocks in source order. Open a block to read it in full with its links.

elements.title: Element provenance
elements.intro: Each methodology element with its provenance and, for templates, the guiding question it answers.
elements.question: Guiding question

block.title: Playbook section
block.intro: One block of the published methodology, with its guidance and what implements it.

links.title: Forms, procedures and requirements
links.intro: What implements this block: open the form's register or the procedure, or launch the procedure.
links.launchIntro: Launching creates a procedure instance with its steps. It approves nothing.
links.transformationHint: Needed for a procedure that runs in a transformation.

demo.banner: Illustrative example — synthetic. Not Mobily actual performance.
demo.illustrative: Illustrative example only. Replace assumptions with validated company data.

branding.title: Branding
branding.intro: Product name, colours, fonts, logo and report header and footer. Saving publishes a new branding version that every screen and every newly generated report reads.
branding.rules: Branding is configuration, not a business approval. The colours stay provisional until you record the reference of a brand approval you hold; #0078FF is a provisional colour, not a verified Mobily colour. Issued reports keep the branding version they were generated with.
branding.settingsIntro: Change the settings and publish them as a new version. There is no draft: publishing takes effect at once.
branding.contrastNavPass: White navigation text on the secondary colour: contrast {{ratio}}:1, meets 4.5:1.
branding.contrastNavFail: White navigation text on the secondary colour: contrast {{ratio}}:1, below 4.5:1. Choose a darker colour.
branding.contrastAccentPass: Primary colour on the page background: contrast {{ratio}}:1, meets 3:1 for accents.
branding.contrastAccentFail: Primary colour on the page background: contrast {{ratio}}:1, below 3:1 for accents.
branding.contrastUnknown: Contrast unknown: enter a valid colour.
branding.actionShade: The colour of buttons and links is derived from the primary colour so that it keeps at least 4.5:1 contrast.
branding.approvalHint: The reference of the brand approval you hold. Recording it approves nothing in this product.
branding.fontsHint: Only the fonts bundled with the product can be used; no font is loaded from the internet.
branding.logoHint: A PNG image of at most 256 KiB, with alternative text in English and Arabic. Without a logo the provisional text wordmark is shown.
branding.reportHint: Enter each in both English and Arabic, or leave both empty.
branding.versionsIntro: Every published version, newest first. Versions never change.
branding.noVersionsBody: The default branding is in use until the first version is published.

environment.title: Environment
environment.intro: Whether this deployment is production or the separate demonstration environment, the demo dataset and its reset.
environment.demoBody: Every record and number here is an illustrative example, not Mobily actual performance, and every approval approves nothing real.
environment.productionBody: This database holds no demonstration records. Demo data lives only in a separately initialized demo database.
environment.noRun: No demo dataset has been seeded in this database.
environment.resetIntro: A reset re-creates the demo database and seeds it again: identical record counts and checksum. Everything demo users added is discarded.
environment.confirmBody: Everything added since the last seed or reset is discarded. Production data is never touched.
environment.queued: Reset requested at {{when}}. It runs in the background; reload this page to see the new run.

walkthrough.title: Guided walkthrough
walkthrough.intro: Twelve steps through the product on the synthetic demonstration data. Each step is done with the product's own screens; the guide only explains and links.
walkthrough.notDemoBody: The guided walkthrough runs on the separate demonstration environment, with synthetic data.
walkthrough.transformationIntro: Step 1 creates a transformation. Choose it here to see which steps it has completed.
walkthrough.open: Open the screen for this step
